title: STEWIE plan release
description: One executable plan IR bound to the context it was planned for (RW-33f, D-R100). An executive refuses to run it when any bound field differs from its live context.

ir_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole IR (sorted-key JSON).

frame.description: The IR frame (crs, origin, charger) as sorted-key JSON.

constraints_sha256.description: Vehicle, objective budgets, mission windows, shared resources, observations, precedence and charger capacity.

dem_sha256.description: The terrain content the routes were computed on.

terrain_memory_head.description: Terrain Memory chain head hash, or 'genesis'.

release_id.description: SHA-256 over every other field (sorted-key JSON).
